explanation: Combined result of the data-origin layout with main's compare cell, study publication record, bundle-reader adoption, study-selection module and HypoMap atlas client. From this change: dataOriginLayout.test.ts is one per-key table (tree, mutability, Cache-Control, Content-Type, purge prefix, WAF admission) with the uploader/WAF and pointer-TTL invariants and build-id parsing; queryGeneration.test.ts runs the reader over a temp directory and an in-memory HTTP origin; the purgePrefixForKey, pathAllowed and queryPublicationPrefixes cases moved into that table; releaseIdentity.test.ts checks every JSON file non-test source imports is a release source. From main: compareCell.test.ts, studyRecord.test.ts, queryIndexCorpus.test.ts, the listDiskCorpus and jsonpHeader cases in bundleReader.test.ts, studySelection.test.tsx and hypomapAtlasClient.test.ts, with geneStudyScope.test.ts and hypomapMetrics.test.ts removed.
